songs.title: a little bitter, and i like it
songs.description: Soul pop for a cafe, E flat major, 88 BPM. Female low alto, half voice, near speech, as if humming to herself, behind the beat. Narrow melody in a fourth, one phrase returning; the chorus keeps those notes and lifts because the band opens, not because she pushes; lines end early. Rounded consonants, almost no vibrato. Full band, dense and soft: muted grand, low, two-note motif, struck short; muted guitar in short double stops; one harmony voice, last chorus, no choir; deep bass in short pairs; side stick, low tom, dark hats every bar, never dropping out. Harmony Ebmaj9 - Gm7 - Gbdim7 - Fm9 - Bb9 to Ebmaj9, sliding down through a diminished chord. Vocals behind the band, blended in, not upfront. Dark warm tone, highs rolled off, lo-fi. Ends on a plucked chord, about two and a half minutes, the lyric filling all of it. One note per syllable, the band carrying every lift. No melisma, no sustained high notes, no head voice, no saxophone, no smoky bar or lounge, no autotune, no pop gloss.

Narrow melody in a fourth, one phrase returning; the chorus keeps those notes and lifts because the band opens, not because she pushes; lines end early. Rounded consonants, almost no vibrato. Full band, dense and soft: electric piano in short chords; nylon guitar off-beat comping only; one harmony voice, last chorus, no choir; bass in short dotted notes; brushes, hats, shaker every bar, never dropping out. No upright bass, no jazz trio. Harmony Bmaj9 - G#m9 - Amaj7 - Emaj9 to Bmaj9, the flat seven through the four, no dominant chords. Vocals behind the band, blended in, not upfront. Warm tone, softened top, tape warmth, lo-fi. Ends on a plucked chord, about two and a half minutes, the lyric filling all of it. One note per syllable, the band carrying every lift. No melisma, no sustained high notes, no head voice, no saxophone, no smoky bar or lounge, no autotune, no pop gloss.
